messages.subject: R in zeleni materiali
parts:
Če se kdo ukvarja z gradbenimi materiali oz. pozna koga, ki se ukvarja z gradbenimi materiali in je vešč analize in sinteze podatkov, pripenjam spodnjo postdoc pozicijo. Pogodba za 2 leti in $55k-85k plače. Nikjer nisem zasledil, da bi bila zadeva omejena za ameriške državljane.


The Postdoctoral Fellows will participate in a major externally funded organizational initiative to understand the characteristics and potential health and environmental impacts of building materials. The Postdoctoral Fellows will conduct synthetic research and analysis, while also contributing to the development and documentation of the Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) green building rating system.
The Postdoctoral Fellows will work under the supervision of the Vice President, Research, with input and direction from Senior Research Fellows, and close coordination with LEED Department technical staff.
The position provide up to 2-years of support. Compensation ranges from $55,000 to no more than $85,000 per year based on qualifications. 

http://www.usgbc.org/Jobs_Internships_Postdoctoral_Fellow
